summary: A seat's host records the seat's staging of graph mail as a local mark, as it already records delivery, read and close, once marks are on and every other member advertises message_staged_reads (db break-up step 4b, staging). Until then a staging stays a message.staged claim.

replay.detail: No claim kind, projection or replay change: a staging mark is stored in local_message_staged, which every release since v0.3.26 reads and folds into the same projections a message.staged claim maintains.

schema.detail: No table, index or schema version change. A new meta key, staged_switched, caches the staging barrier; an older build ignores it.

rules.detail: No claim rule change. The transition rules read a staging mark as they read a staged claim.

compatibility.detail: A member of this build records its own seats' stagings as marks only while marks are on and every other member's own newest daemon.started advertises message_staged_reads=1 (v0.3.27 on), read the same strict way as the marks barrier, and in the writer's own transaction. Beside a member that does not advertise it (v0.3.26 and earlier), stagings stay claims, which that member reads as it always has, while delivery, read and close stay marks where marks are on. A member alone turns stagings to marks at once. A member that joins or restarts without the feature turns stagings back to claims on every member within a minute. Doctor's message-marks check says whether stagings are marks and, while they are not, which members hold them off.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs before the daemon serves.

recovery.detail: Rolling a member back to v0.3.26 is safe: v0.3.26 reads its own seats' staging marks, so nothing is offered again on a seat's host, and every other member turns stagings back to claims within a minute. Until a message staged by a mark is delivered, a v0.3.26 member shows it as sent when it reads another host's seat, and as staged once delivery moves it on; after that minute new stagings are claims again. Rolling back to v0.3.25 or earlier is NOT safe for a member that hosts seats: those releases do not read local_message_staged, so mail its seats had staged as a mark but not yet delivered reads as unoffered and is offered again (a duplicate delivery), and their message views on any member show it as sent. To roll back below v0.3.26, first roll every member to v0.3.26, wait a minute for stagings to turn back to claims, and let staged mail deliver.
